sequences.name: Sleepless
abilities: High Spirituality: High spiritual perception and sensitivity.
Spirit Vision: Can use Spirit Vision to see spiritual things.
Divination Arts & Ritualistic Magic: Can do limited Divination and Ritualistic Magic using potent Spirituality.
Nocturnality: The deeper into the night, the more powerful they become. Can see through darkness, sense dangers hidden in the dark, and only need 3-4 hours of rest per day.

sequences.name: Midnight Poet
abilities: Midnight Poem: Can cast effects through recital of a poem related to the night or Evernight Goddess.
Tranquilize: Can make people's bodies, hearts, and souls feel purified and Tranquil.
Lullaby: Can put multiple people to sleep via a Lullaby.
Pacify: Can tranquilize opponents and make them lose their desire to live.
Nocturnality: Enhanced degree of enhancement.

sequences.name: Nightmare
abilities: High Spirituality: Significantly enhanced Spirituality.
Nightmare State: Can separate Soul from physical body while sleeping to move freely and infiltrate Dreams.
Dream Shaping: Can cause different changes within a target's Dreams to guide their behavior.
Dream Invasion: Can forcefully drag targets into Dreams without alerting them.
Nightmare Limbs: Can generate tentacle-like Nightmare Limbs from their back for close combat.

sequences.name: Soul Assurer
abilities: High Spirituality: Slightly enhanced Spirituality.
Ritualistic Magic & Divination Arts: Improvements in spiritual abilities.
Requiem: Can cause the Spirit Body to sleep, suppressing desires, moods, and thoughts.
Dream Invasion: Can force targets in Dreams within a 150 meter range.
Midnight Poem: Can use signing to manifest effects.
Agitate: Can agitate the Spirit Body, heightening frustrations and destructive urges.
Nocturnality: Only need two hours of rest per day.

sequences.name: Spirit Warlock
abilities: Spirit Commanding: Can Seal various Spirits within teeth and release them.
Dream Invasion: Range increased to 200 meters.

sequences.name: Nightwatcher
abilities: Bloodline Abilities: Bloodline traits of True Deities' descendants grant new abilities.
Night Domain: Can make pure Darkness surge to form a domain that boosts capabilities and weakens enemies.
Hair Entanglement: Can create and manipulate countless hairs to bind enemies.
Concealment: Possesses powers over Concealment.
Curse of Misfortune: Can give a certain amount of Misfortune to others.
Luck Sensation: Can sense when Luck has been altered.
Spirit Commanding: Enhanced ability to control Spirits.
Requiem: Undergone qualitative change; can induce sleep and Pacify deceased Spirits.
Nocturnality: The darker the environment, the stronger their strength.
Dream Invasion: Expanded to 1000 meters.

sequences.name: Horror Bishop
abilities: Sword of Darkness: A bone sword combining Repose and Horror; creates a tide of Darkness.
Nightmare World: Can create a Dream world and pull everyone in range into it.
Horror Aura: Causes target's body and mind to tremble involuntarily.
Midnight Poem: Greatly enhanced; can put an entire city to sleep.
Spirit Commanding: Enhanced abilities with spirit.

sequences.name: Servant of Concealment
abilities: Concealment: Can make targets enter a Concealed state that cannot be sensed.
Reverse Concealment: Can remove the Concealed state from a target.
Concealed World: Can create an entire area that is Concealed by itself.
Nightmare World: Range can affect a large city.
Requiem: Mere presence can bring extreme peace.

sequences.name: Knight of Misfortune
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Strength, agility, physique, and speed are true to the title of Knight.
Misfortune: Can give Misfortune to enemies, including national-scale Misfortune.
Servant of Darkness: In the Dark Night, almost impossible to be truly killed.
Sword of Darkness: Brings Eternal Rest, Despair, and Destruction.
Commander of Spirits: Can put Natural and Undead Spirits to sleep and command them.

sequences.name: Darkness
abilities: Concealment: Can Conceal traces, mislead prying and Divination, and grasp many secrets.
Darkness: Can induce Dreams, bring peace or Eternal Rest, and dissolve targets into Darkness.
Spirit Body & Spirituality: Master of Spirits; destination of Spirits.
Misfortune & Catastrophe: Can bring Catastrophes via Misfortune.
Horror: Embodiment of Horror; can make others feel tremendous fear.
